findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_correction" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_part, get_repair_guide, submit_correction · Private data: search_parts, resolve_request, get_model_parts, get_part, get_part_fits, check_part_fits, submit_correction · Public sink: submit_correction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_part, get_repair_guide, submit_correction · Private data: search_parts, resolve_request, get_model_parts, get_part, get_part_fits, check_part_fits, submit_correction · Public sink: submit_correction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
